name: linear-migration-deep-dive
description: Plan and execute a controlled migration into Linear using supported import assistants or the CLI importer. Use when moving issues from Jira, GitHub, Asana, Shortcut, another Linear workspace, or CSV. Trigger with "migrate to Linear", "import issues into Linear", or "plan Linear cutover".

findings.excerpt: Use `Read`, `Glob`, and `Grep` to inspect code, configuration, and evidence. Use `WebFetch` only for current first-party Linear documentation and package metada
